_about: explainer-fast sound pools. A plan (or a default) names a pool, e.g. "whoosh"; the renderer plays one variant, chosen by shot/graphic number so neighbours differ and re-renders sound the same. Any exact file name in library/sfx (e.g. "whoosh_r3") still works. gain = extra volume for files that are recorded quiet. Read by ExplainerFast.tsx, Graphics.tsx and engine/tools/check_plan.py.
